sin.name: span-worked-out-by-hand
sin.description: A span of time or of tool uses is worked out by hand anywhere in the code: a subtraction of a moment, an _at field, a start or a tool use count, compared with a number or a setting.
sin.rule: Ask a Timeout from support/timeout.py instead: Timeout.seconds(n), minutes(n) or tool_uses(n), started at the moment counted from, asked is_elapsed (at least the span), is_exceeded (more than the span) or is_active (within the span from its start), or has_passed when spans in other units are combined. A tolerance, the size of a difference wrapped in abs, is no span.
